tips.text: Plant a seed with Rampant Growth before you cast Grasping Roots or Deadly Spines near it. The seed grows into a plant that fights for you.
Use Grasping Roots first on a target you want to catch. They are rooted and can't walk out of your Deadly Spines.
Set a trap by putting seeds in brush. Lure enemies in, then root them with Grasping Roots.
Vine Lashers from Grasping Roots slow with their attacks, so use them when you need to chase or hold an enemy in place.
Cast Stranglethorns on top of your plants. They get stronger and last longer, and enemies in the thicket are knocked up.
Aim Stranglethorns so enemies can't easily leave the area. They take damage at once and are knocked up after a short delay.
Keep a charge of Rampant Growth for fights. Killing minions and monsters speeds up the recharge, and a champion takedown refills it fully.
Plant seeds on key paths and objectives to see what enemies are doing. Seeds give your team vision.
Plant a seed with Rampant Growth in a brush or near the lane, then cast Grasping Roots through it to grow a Vine Lasher that slows the enemy.
Cast Deadly Spines onto a seed to grow a Thorn Spitter. It adds steady ranged damage to your poke while the enemy is stuck near it.
Put a seed down after you cast your spell, so it lands where the spell is going to hit and the plant still grows.
Aim Grasping Roots at an enemy who is walking up to attack. Once they are rooted, follow up with Deadly Spines and let your ally finish them.
Seeds from Rampant Growth give your team vision. Put them in brush and river entrances to spot ganks and set traps.
Keep a charge of Rampant Growth in reserve. Seeds are what turn your spells into plants, so a fight without any seeds is much weaker.
At level 6, cast Stranglethorns over enemies standing near your plants. It knocks them up and makes your plants stronger.
Enemies can destroy your seeds by stepping on them. Plant seeds where they won't walk, or where you can use them straight away.

combos.name: Seed behind the cast
combos.when: When you want a Vine Lasher out of a root cast and no seed is lying where the enemy is standing.
combos.text: Cast Grasping Roots first, then drop a seed in the path of the vines. They grow it into a Vine Lasher, and the enemy can't see the seed coming.

tips.text: Cast Grasping Roots on Graves when he dashes in; he is rooted and cannot dash away to escape.
Place seeds with Rampant Growth in brush and along Graves' path, then grow them with Deadly Spines to catch him.
Graves deals mostly physical damage with short range, so stay at long range and keep plants between you and him.
Use Stranglethorns on Graves when plants are nearby; it knocks him up and powers up your plants.
Stay out of the line between Jarvan and his Demacian Standard; Dragon Strike knocks you up along that path.
Save Grasping Roots for when Jarvan jumps in or dashes to his flag, so he is rooted and cannot follow up.
Place seeds with Rampant Growth in brush and near your fight spot. Jarvan can step on them to destroy them.
Cast Stranglethorns on Jarvan's Cataclysm arena. He is stuck with your plants, and the knock up lands while he is trapped.
Hit Jarvan with Deadly Spines from range before he reaches you, and fight near plants.
Save Grasping Roots for when Kayn dashes in or leaves a wall; being rooted ends his Shadow Step at once.
Watch for the warning on the terrain edge when Kayn is in a wall near you, and keep Grasping Roots ready.
Dodge Blade's Reach so Kayn cannot easily start Umbral Trespass from long range.
Plant seeds in brush and grow them with Deadly Spines or Grasping Roots to trap Kayn; plants help you hold him off.
Use Stranglethorns on Kayn when he commits so the knock up lands, ideally over your plants.
Stay near your minions or allies. Kha'Zix's Taste Their Fear hits far harder when you are isolated.
Plant seeds in brush and on likely approach paths. If he steps on one, it reveals him and ruins his ambush.
Root him with Grasping Roots when he leaps in, then back away. Do it over a seed to get a Vine Lasher that slows him.
Kha'Zix is weak while Leap and Void Assault are on cooldown. Hit him with Deadly Spines then, and trade.
Save Stranglethorns for when he dives onto you or a teammate. It knocks him up, and your plants in it get stronger.
Hit Kindred with Grasping Roots when she dashes in or walks up to attack; she is fragile and cannot escape once rooted.
Put Rampant Growth seeds in brush and on her likely path, then cast Grasping Roots over them for a Vine Lasher that slows her.
Pressure Kindred early. She is fragile, and Deadly Spines hits hard on her when she stops to fight a camp.
Hold Stranglethorns for a fight where Kindred has already used Lamb's Respite, or wait it out; it can save her and her team from dying.
Kill Kindred before her marks stack up. Every hunt she finishes makes her abilities stronger for the rest of the game.
Grasping Roots is your best answer when Lee Sin dashes in. Hold it until he commits with Resonating Strike.
Plant seeds in brush and on his jungle paths, then grow them with Deadly Spines when he steps near for a trap.
Lee Sin can kick you with Dragon's Rage into your allies. Stay spread out.
Deal magic damage to Lee Sin. He has tools against physical damage.
Keep your plants grown by Grasping Roots near you in a fight. Lee Sin must deal with them while chasing you.
Aim Grasping Roots at Master Yi when he lands. Highlander won't stop a root, and he can't act while rooted.
Stranglethorns knocks him up even with Highlander active. Save it for when he dives you.
Don't expect Vine Lashers to slow him once Highlander is running. Rely on Grasping Roots instead.
Hide seeds in brush and lure him in; he often walks over them, which destroys them. Place them where he won't step on them.
Deadly Spines has a short delay, and Master Yi is untargetable during Alpha Strike. Hit him after he reappears.
Keep hitting him from range so he spends mana on Meditate to heal.
Aim Grasping Roots at Naafiri when she is about to dash in. A rooted assassin cannot jump away, and she is easy to follow up on.
Save Stranglethorns for when Naafiri commits to a fight. It knocks her up and enrages your plants.
Plant seeds with Rampant Growth in the brush and around your objective. Then grow them with Deadly Spines or Grasping Roots when she walks in.
Stay near your plants and your team. Naafiri wants to catch you alone, so don't wander off to place seeds.
Use Deadly Spines on her early, when she is clearing camps. It hurts her and her packmates will stay on the target.
Aim Grasping Roots through a seed so a Vine Lasher grows. Its attacks slow Nocturne when he dives in.
Do not throw Grasping Roots at Nocturne while Shroud of Darkness is ready. It blocks the root and speeds up his attacks.
Stay near your allies once Paranoia goes off. Nocturne can dash to you and you cannot see far.
Keep seeds planted around you with Rampant Growth before a fight. Nocturne's dash then lands among plants.
Keep your distance from Nocturne when Unspeakable Horror is ready. Walk away to break the tether before the fear lands.
Hit Shyvana with Grasping Roots as she runs at you, then back away so she can't reach you.
Keep your distance from Shyvana; she is weak against enemies who stay out of reach.
Hold Stranglethorns for when Shyvana dives in; it knocks her up and powers up your plants.
Plant seeds with Rampant Growth in the brush and along her path, then grow them with Deadly Spines as she walks in.
Keep Grasping Roots for when Skarner charges at you. Rooting him ends Ixtal's Impact.
Place seeds with Rampant Growth in brush and near your lane. They show you Skarner when he steps on them and help you spot a gank.
Stay away from walls when Skarner is close. A wall behind you lets Ixtal's Impact stun you.
Use Stranglethorns on Skarner when he is fighting among your plants. It knocks him up and makes the plants hit harder.
Step out of the way of Impale, or use an escape. Skarner is easier to fight when you keep your distance and poke with Deadly Spines.
Hit Sylas with Grasping Roots when he dashes in; rooted, he can't use Abscond or Kingslayer to escape.
Do not trust Sylas's health bar; Kingslayer heals him more when he is low. Finish him fast or back off.
Plant seeds in brush and walk-up spots, then fight there. Grasping Roots or Deadly Spines through a seed gives you plants to help the fight.
Save Stranglethorns for when Sylas is stuck in a fight; it knocks him up and powers up your plants.
Stay behind your team when you have your ultimate; Sylas can steal Stranglethorns, so do not use it when he can hijack you.
Keep Grasping Roots for when Talon jumps in. If he is rooted, he cannot easily escape you and your plants.
Plant seeds with Rampant Growth in brush and around your camps. They show you Talon, who can turn invisible and roam.
When Talon vanishes with Shadow Assault, stay near your plants and wait for him to appear. He has to attack you to hurt you.
Stranglethorns knocks Talon up and makes your plants stronger. Cast it on him when he dives onto you beside your plants.
Land Grasping Roots on Viego when he commits to a fight; he is rooted and can't dash in with Spectral Maw or escape.
Plant a seed in brush, then hit it with Grasping Roots or Deadly Spines so a plant helps when Viego walks in.
Cast Stranglethorns on Viego and your plants together; it knocks him up and makes the plants hit harder.
Fight away from Viego's kill zone; if a champion dies, he can possess them, so stay near your team and don't get picked off alone.
Stay behind your team when Viego is in his Mist; he is hidden there, so place seeds near it to spot him.
Keep Xin Zhao away with Grasping Roots when he charges. A rooted Xin Zhao cannot easily reach you.
Plant seeds with Rampant Growth near your fight spot, then hit them with Deadly Spines for plants that damage him while he tries to reach you.
Stay away from Xin Zhao once his Three Talon Strike is ready; the third attack knocks you up. Hit him before he lands it.
Use Stranglethorns on Xin Zhao and your plants when he dives in. It knocks him up and makes your plants stronger.
Aim Grasping Roots through a Seed when you can; the Vine Lasher it grows slows Bard and his partner when they fight near it.
Keep your distance from Bard. Cosmic Binding stuns if it hits a second enemy or a wall, so don't line up behind your carry or next to terrain.
Plant Rampant Growth seeds in the brush and on his usual paths. Bard can crush them by walking over them, but you will see him when he does.
Wait for Bard to spend Magical Journey before you dive or all-in. A portal lets him and his ally escape or roam quickly.
Do not jump into Tempered Fate with Stranglethorns. Anyone caught in it is frozen in stasis, so hold your ultimate until it has ended.
Use Deadly Spines on Bard when he walks up to grab a chime or shrine. He is easy to hit while he is busy.
Throw Grasping Roots when Braum has his shield down; Unbreakable intercepts it and the first hit deals no damage.
Aim Deadly Spines at the ground where Braum is going to stand. It lands after a short delay, so it is hard for him to block.
Keep your distance from Braum and stay out of Winter's Bite range, since it stops at the first enemy it hits and slows. A minion in front of you can soak it.
Step out of the way during the long delay on Glacial Fissure, then avoid the frozen ground it leaves.
Do not stand beside Braum for long. Each hit adds to Concussive Blows and the fourth stack stuns you.
Grow plants with Deadly Spines or Grasping Roots from your seeds when Karma stands near them, since her blast hits only the first target.
Karma's Inner Flame stops at the first unit it hits, so stand behind your plants or minions to block it.
Move away when Karma tethers you with Focused Resolve; breaking the tether stops the root.
Root Karma with Grasping Roots when she uses Mantra, then follow with Deadly Spines for extra damage.
Keep Grasping Roots for when Leona starts to walk up. Rooting her stops the engage before her stun lands.
Stay behind your plants and back away from Leona. Her Zenith Blade has long range, so do not stand in a straight line with allies.
Plant seeds in brush and lane paths with Rampant Growth. Leona's Zenith Blade sets off the plants you grow when she walks in.
Do not stand in the middle of Solar Flare. Walk out of the center and you are slowed instead of stunned.
Use Deadly Spines on Leona from range while her Eclipse is down. Back off while Eclipse is up, since it makes her sturdy.
Plant seeds in the path of Grasping Roots so a Vine Lasher grows and slows Lulu and her partner.
Stay out of Glitterlance's line, because it passes through enemies and slows you; keep minions between you and Lulu.
Use Deadly Spines on Lulu from long range when she walks up to attack; she is easy to poke.
Respect Whimsy; Lulu can polymorph you when you step forward, so stay away when it is ready.
Cast Stranglethorns over your plants so they grow stronger and the knock up catches enemies in them.
Lux's Light Binding roots the first two enemies it hits. Stay out of line with your partner, and keep minions between you and Lux.
Use Rampant Growth to place seeds in the grass or near the lane before you fight. Then Grasping Roots grows a Vine Lasher.
Lux is easy to hit when she stands still. Land Grasping Roots on her, then follow up with Deadly Spines while she is rooted.
Lux's Lucent Singularity slows you when you walk through it. Step around it and don't stand in it while Lux is nearby.
Move to the side when Lux's Final Spark warning line appears. Stranglethorns on her team is a strong way to answer it.
Land Grasping Roots on Milio when he walks up to help his carry; being rooted in place stops him from escaping and keeps him in your damage.
Aim Grasping Roots through a seed so a Vine Lasher grows and slows anyone who stays near it.
Dodge Ultra Mega Fire Kick by stepping aside; it stops at the first enemy it hits, so keep minions from standing in front of you.
Use Deadly Spines on Milio when he stands still to cast; his casts lock him in place briefly, so he can't dodge easily.
Save Stranglethorns for when Milio and his carry group up; it knocks them up and powers your plants.
Plant a seed with Rampant Growth near your lane, then hit it with Grasping Roots so a Vine Lasher grows and slows Nami when she steps up.
Aim Grasping Roots at Nami right after she misses Aqua Prison; she has no easy way to get away while rooted.
Aqua Prison lands slowly, so keep walking and never stand still in the bubble's target area.
Use Deadly Spines on Nami from long range to poke her down, and grow a Thorn Spitter by casting it near a seed.
Hold back when Nami's ally has Tidecaller's Blessing; it fades fast, so wait it out before you trade.
Sidestep Tidal Wave when you see it coming; it travels slowly. At level 6, use Stranglethorns on grouped enemies and plants nearby.
Keep your distance from Nautilus; Dredge Line pulls you in and stuns you, and Grasping Roots is your answer once he is close.
Root Nautilus with Grasping Roots when he walks in; it also grows any seed it passes into a Vine Lasher.
Plant seeds with Rampant Growth around you and behind you so Nautilus has to step on them to reach you.
Hit Nautilus with Deadly Spines near a seed to make a Thorn Spitter that pokes him from range.
When Nautilus is shielded, don't fight his attacks; they also damage everyone near his target.
Plant seeds in brush and along the path Pantheon will take, then grow them when he walks in. Plants give you extra damage in a fight.
Aim Grasping Roots at Pantheon as he jumps in. Rooted, he can't dash away and your plants get free hits.
Wait for Aegis Assault to end before you use your spells on Pantheon. Spells from the front do nothing to him while it lasts.
Stay away from Pantheon when your health is low. Comet Spear hits hard against low-health targets.
Use Deadly Spines to damage Pantheon from range before he can reach you. Keep distance so Shield Vault has to cross the gap.
Move out of the way when Grand Starfall gives its warning. Pantheon lands where he aimed, so don't stand there.
Grow a plant with Grasping Roots when Pyke walks up to hook you; the root holds him in place and the Vine Lasher keeps slowing him.
Keep Rampant Growth seeds in the bushes and near you. Pyke has to step on them to reach you, and that reveals him.
Stay behind your minions. Bone Skewer stops at the first enemy it hits, so a minion in the way soaks the hook.
Hold Grasping Roots for when Pyke dashes in with Phantom Undertow, so he is rooted before he can follow up.
Stay away from low-health allies when Pyke is around. Death From Below can execute them and teleport him onto you.
Use Deadly Spines to poke Pyke while he stays in the lane. Once he hides and heals, change targets.
Aim Grasping Roots at Senna when she walks up to attack; she has little room to dodge and is rooted where she stands.
Plant a seed with Rampant Growth, then hit it with Deadly Spines so a Thorn Spitter helps you poke Senna.
Senna outranges you, so stay out of her line and use plants to trade back when she pokes.
Stay out of Last Embrace's path; it rolls to the first enemy hit, so keep a minion in front of you.
Use Stranglethorns on Senna and her partner together, and it also powers up your plants nearby.
Plant a seed with Rampant Growth, then hit it with Grasping Roots to grow a Vine Lasher that slows Seraphine and her partner when they step up to trade.
Aim Grasping Roots at Seraphine when she walks up to cast. Once she is rooted, follow with Deadly Spines.
Keep your distance and use Deadly Spines on Seraphine. Grow a Thorn Spitter beside it to keep up the poke.
Don't stand in a line with your partner. Her Beat Drop slows everyone it hits, and a slowed target is rooted by her next one.
Wait for level 6. Stranglethorns knocks up everyone in the thicket and powers up your plants, so use it when the fight is around your plants.
Plant seeds, then hit them with Grasping Roots or Deadly Spines so plants fight with you.
Sona has few escapes, so catch her with Grasping Roots and then follow with Deadly Spines.
Stay away from Sona's Hymn of Valor range; it hits your nearest plants and you, so keep the plants as a screen.
Stay spread from your carry when Crescendo is up, so one stun does not catch both of you.
Plant a seed with Rampant Growth, then cast Grasping Roots through it. A Vine Lasher then slows Thresh and his partner while you keep poking.
Stay out of Death Sentence range and watch his cast start. Step sideways, because the scythe stops at the first unit it hits.
Land Grasping Roots on Thresh when he comes in to hook. Being rooted stops him from following up.
Use Deadly Spines on seeds to grow Thorn Spitters. They keep poking from range and help you hold the lane.
Save Stranglethorns for when Thresh and his partner are grouped. Cast it over your plants so they get stronger too.
